items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: And the Rykers came back. And then we had called Chauncey because, well just out of pure intrigue. So he came down from New York.

ctx.x: But then disaster fell upon us, you know in just a few months. Almost gone one of us... In August we met, I think it was. I don't remember the exact date of that meeting at Donoho's. And the Rykers came back. And then we had called Chauncey because, well just out of pure intrigue. So he came down from New York. And we had a marvelous gabfest here. And Paul Hertz, I forgot about him.
